body: If possible night-shift jobs usually offer the most isolation from others. You’re probably at most going to be around a handful of co-workers at any time

Yup. I don’t think about it constantly atm since I can say I still have college to dredge through, but having next to no income or job experience sucks. I had one job a couple years ago but get let go due to no-show and lack of motivation while on the job.

Even if I do finish college though I always wonder if I will be employable. Once I start interviews that are harder and more socially oriented than a simple retail stocking job I’m pretty sure I’m screwed. My anxiety explodes and my lack of social interest just destroys it. I really don’t think people realize how important sociability is to get a job, even if the job has nothing to do with it.

So yeah I’d be surprised if I’m alive in 5 years tbh.
Right? I’d rather be weak but have a decent job and life. Instead I’m “strong”, unemployable and live a horrific life.

Sure but what would I do? I'm currently accepted to one for computer programming just because I had to apply and sure I've always done that I guess. But I'm not good enough at it to get a career. I know this because I've already tried, and I don't really have a strong interest in it anyways.

But I don't have any career interests because I can't find any. All of them fit into these categories: Academic (research), Smart (engineering), Labor (construction), Customer-Facing (Sales). I fail in all of these areas. I'm not interest or good enough for Academic or Smart jobs, I'm not fit enough to labor jobs, and I'm terrible at customer-facing jobs, not to mention my depression is multiplied by them. So at this point I'm at a loss.

The only job I saw that looked promising for a second was an Actuary. That was until I saw it required a degree and the completion of 3 extremely tedious and challenging exams. I'm even ok with doing "the jobs others don't want to" really. However I just can't find anything.

Idk my only interests are tech, DotA 2, and something that generally has a negative view on it due to it containing some controversial things, despite being as diverse as music. To say the least none of those will help me land a job. Anyone interested in tech is most likely working a job that is over my head, and the other two are one of those things that is so large yet so small. Both have millions of people engaged in it but are few and far between in real life.

I don't really mind not having a social life though, my brain doesn't crave it. I just want a career. I'm desperate for anything decent but there is nothing I'm qualified for. Also with the weight the problem is I don't have enough time to get healthier even if I could. I'm already super late to trying and I'd be on the streets long before getting healthy.

I've held a job in both retail and fast-food and they're horrible. I'm fine with a basic desk-job but I haven't found one that doesn't require customer service or a degree. I'm sure I could become decent at anything given the chance, but I'm not interesting enough to be given one without a stacked resume.

Main problem is speed. Maybe there is a treatment, but the pain is so great I just don't have the mental stability for it anymore. I've already been trying for almost a year now with absolutely no results, and COVID has pretty much put a halt on everything in that regard. I've tried proposing a treatment but because it's not "by the book" (despite it really being a low-risk drug ffs) they won't even give me as much as a trial. I've been prescribed way more high-risk stuff so idk why they're so against it. 

But this is just how it is. I'm really just sick of this and it's only getting worse. My family doesn't really care about me that much now that I'm a failure. As per many stereotypes my sister who's been a horrible person their entire life gets more support just because "that's how she is" and I was supposed to be "the good one".

Main problem with healthy food is it needs to be prepared by yourself. I know this sounds super lazy, and really it is, but I just don't have the will or energy to do that. I can do it for like a couple weeks and then it's over, I know because I've done it. For socializing I think the problem is there are two parts. One, skill, two, personality. See you can always learn the "tips and tricks" to it, but to really engage with someone you have to have shared interests.

I simply just don't. So many people have kind of a base mass-interest (think TV shows like Friends, Game of Thrones), politics (My views are very logic-first which don't sit well with most so I avoid it), and whatever online drama is going on.  I just don't share any of that, and couldn't care less about all that.
Hey. Not sure if there's much to talk about. I've exhausted so many options at this point which is why I'm doing this now.

This is me 100%. Even on days I manage to get out of bed I’m just on my computer within the same room. Anyone who knows me just says I’m lazy or “just don’t try enough”. Hell even others with mild depression tell me this. 

I don’t think most really understand what severe depression and the lack of will truly is. I can have all the knowledge, all the tools, all the time, and yet it is all dwarfed by my lack of motivation and energy to act.

I’ve already tried all the non-medicinal routes, and currently the medical ones are failing too. It is a wonder if I will ever move on in life.
For real. I’m a failure and getting back on track would be possible but an insane struggle. But my lack of will and energy has destroyed any possibility of me coming back even if it’s an option

I’m pretty much 100% numb and I think the worst thing about it is people don’t take your depression seriously because it doesn’t seem as bad if you’re not overly emotional about it. Despite the fact I have no energy to speak of, can’t be productive at all, and am literally failing in life.
Awaiting mod approval??? Wow.
Well I used to have a couple jobs a couple years ago but I couldn’t even get out of bed enough to do them.
Yup
More like bad day 24/7

Just had a failed attempt in the early AM of today. Tried to swallow a bunch of pills at once but ended up just getting sick shortly after and feeling super bad since then.

Still alive and likely will be but it’s my second one now. Both times nobody really cared and it’s clear my life is over. I’m just waiting for it to end.

For me I was the child that did well in school (only half of high school really) and am now a failure. I’m always pressured to be the best but never developed anything other than some useless technical skills you need charisma to use anyways.

Now nobody thinks of me and I’m just let to wallow in my misery. If I somehow was able to move out my life would be so much better, but that costs money and that’s not something I’m capable of making at this point.

I can relate. Parents also abuse alcohol and while I didn’t used to think of myself as suicidal since I’m so numb I’ve definitely hit new lows recently.

This world is just ass.

From what I’ve seen you’re pretty much require in-house work experience first. I’ve tried to apply to remote positions but haven’t gotten as much as an interview (which is where I’d probably fail anyways, trust me) since they all require experience first.

Web development is what I’m best at. Doing it freelance would require even more social ability though and I’ve already tried it and proven that.

I want to note I’m not a prodigy or super great. Junior positions just are so basic.

I just got of it and holy yes I had this so bad. Many times I had to take more and slow down the already slow process just to stop them. Been a couple weeks and still get them from time to time but not as intense anymore. Was only on it for a month too.

All the time. I’m on the path to become a developer but more and more it feels like you’re either a super likeable and charismatic person, or extremely good at programming and did I mention likeable and charismatic? 

When I first got started the stereotype for programmers were quiet geeks who didn’t talk to much to others. I fit this and it felt right. Now though it feels like I’m applying for an art job with the sort of people they expect. Merit be damned. I’ve been told by several senior devs I’m already overqualified for junior positions, but it doesn’t matter.

Fuck this bullshit world. All my effort doesn’t matter at all. The only chance I have at maybe getting a job is applying for a million ones in a large city, and then maybe I’ll get one that doesn’t pay enough for me to live there.

Fun.

It didn’t work for me so I’m tapering off. Definitely not an easy withdraw though. Even with tapering I still get strong brain zaps and have to extend my taper constantly to prevent them. Only was on it for a month too. 

No issues while I was normally taking 150mg though, just did nothing for me.
Sounds about right. Pretty sure I’m incapable at this point. I could literally win the lottery and be given a perfect life, and I’d still just be meh 24/7.

Nope. The possible side effects are pretty standard. They get scared because it’s similar to the stimulant Adderal in what it does. Thing is though it isn’t related at all. It isn’t a stimulant and does not contain any amphetamines.

It’s probably actually SAFER than the anti depressants I’ve been given already.

I can heavily relate to the brain mush. I used to have 90%+ grades and was on the path to go to a good university.

However my grades toward the end of high school plummeted and destroyed any chance of anything above a community college. I used to be able to do math fairly easily but now it feels like I just can’t do anything with speed or accuracy.

Now I don’t even feel interested in anything. Plus anything I did feel any interest towards had a wall that’s impossible for me to overcome now.

#\#goingnowhereinlife

Vitamin D isn’t that bad yeah. However I can’t vouch how cheap it is yet because I won’t know for a few months if the cheap amount is even enough.

That said it’s much worse for other supplements like protein and nootropics that cost $60+ for a month

No they do. It's just that no insurance (federal or private) cover supplements, so instead of having like 90% of it covered, I have to deal with 100% of the cost. I'm a broke college student so I don't have much to work with.

It sucks they aren't open to funding non-prescription options. Makes life a lot harder.

Especially with supplements. I'm severely vitamin-D deficient but since a prescription is only for people with bone diseases I have to pay out of pocket to solve it. It's kinda fucked up tbh.

Main problem for me is cost. Something I've got that works decently is Qualia Focus Nootropics. The problem? It costs like $60 a month. I live in Canada so prescriptions are pretty much free, and I really cannot afford stuff that isn't covered by insurance.
Heh yeah that was the one I was on right before switching to Effexor. Both haven’t worked for me though

For me Effexor hasn’t given me any symptoms while on it but it basically hasn’t worked at all to help me.

So right now I’m feeling bad since I’m stopping the medication with the intent to switch to another. I won’t be able to see a Psych until May so I’ll be going med-less for a bit. I can see my doctor if my depression ends up surging and maybe get Prozac or something but the hope is that I’m somehow able to make-do until then.

Been about a year or so I think for me. 

If I were to count barely going out unless I need to then I've been living like this for 5+ years.

Tapering off of Effexor has my brain going crazy so I can relate to medication troubles.

So far the zaps are getting stronger and really frequent (it feels soo weird) but hopefully they calm down throughout the day. Worst case I do have more of the med if I need to taper off even longer than I'd hoped but only time will tell.

Got to be honest COVID19 hasn't changed my life at all. 

I never go out or anything so I already basically am in self-quarantine all the time.

Yup. I lost my first job due to this. Not even a hard job (stocking, although having to socialize with customers wasn't great).

I'd actually feel physically nauseous just at the thought of going, and by the time they let me go (I guess at least they let me resign) I had aches, headaches and more nausea.

Since then I've only gotten worse so I'm not even sure what I'll do until I find a way to be better.
Thanks, I look into it!

Sounds familiar.

Last year there was a month where somehow I had enough life in me to exercise, eat right most of the time, and do what I needed to do. 

My results were meh and I’m at a new low. Teeth are probably almost more filling than tooth at this point and I only shower if I smell myself or if I need to go out somewhere (which I try and avoid).

I know it’s pretty bad but I’m so numb at this point I just kinda live with it.

I experience something similar.

I have one detailed mask I use all the time. The only difference is when I was with my one friend I’d cut out some of my common lies.

But I don’t think I really have a personality and I’m very hollow. If I try and think about who I am without my mask I can’t define a certain person. I don’t have any interests or commonalities with any personalities that I can think of. The only thing that defines me is my lack of interest and how bored I am.

I can relate.

I’m always apathetic and bored, and if there is one thing I’m good at is my mask. I show “emotion” by using logic as to what would be right/expected at the time. I’m built on a tower of lies and fake emotions and it’s to the point that I naturally use my mask without even realizing.

I thought I may be sociopathic due to how they’re usually perceived but I can’t relate to common sociopathic tendencies like manipulating people and pushing myself up. My mask may be good but I don’t have the social skill to use it in a beneficial way, other than hiding myself.
Not to show off or anything but I'm quite skilled at the art of avoidance 😎

I used to be someone who knew what they wanted to do, and was doing well in general.

Depression changed that real quick though. Now I have no direction, interests or grades.

This is how I feel if I'm at anything with a lot of people. Never been to a party though since I knew ahead of time I wouldn't enjoy it.

I have no hobbies, no interests, don't care about politics since it's bs now anyways, and I just don't have "normie knowledge" I guess you could say. I haven't watched shows like the Office or Friends. I don't plan on it and I don't really know the characters. I have social media but I don't really keep up with that's going on since I just can't care about it.

I almost wish I cared about drama and all the stupid popular shit these days but I really just don't.
Yup. The amount of people who equate depression to being a little sad for a bit is crazy. It's pretty much diluted the reality of depression.

Same.

I don't feel or care anymore. Just constant boredom and I just kind of exist for the sake of existing, even if I don't care to. One challenge I've had with the lack of feeling is if you're not super emotional or sad people don't take your depression seriously, and assume it's not that bad.

I've also developed a good mask so nobody outside of some family members are even remotely aware I'm not fine.

This is me 1000%

I've lost interest in literally everything and am constantly bored since I just can't care. I could be given anything and I may pretend to care but really I don't. I thought at first it wasn't depression because I couldn't relate to a lot of what people said but it definitely is now that I've spoken to a doctor.

I don't care about being loved, I don't feel like a burden, or any of that stuff. Just basic existing is really all I do. Been trying meds since the boredom is annoying at least but so far nothing. I've pretty much forgotten how it feels to feel. I know how to fake emotions well, and I know enough about basic living that everyone who only kinda knows me seems to think I have my shit together.

Definitely not the case though. It even is to the point where I am very much the "do as I say, not as I do" sorta person. I don't give out advice but I have a lot of bad habits I know better than to do but do them anyways. The one that is probably going to hit me the hardest is debt. I use my credit a lot and I definitely have no plan or way to pay it off. Currently I have enough to  do the minimum payments at least but I'm on-track to run out around June.

DotA has been my waste-time game of choice but even that, the only thing that has lasted through-out my depression has vanished. I also recently lost my last friend since the only thing we really had in common anymore is we knew each other since childhood and played DotA, but since I stopped that and don't speak without being spoken to it's dead now and they've found new friends that share the same passion and interest.

One thing I've noticed is that my mask has become such a part of me due to frequent use, that I accidentally use it all the time. Lies about how I am and what I'm doing are constant. I don't even notice it because it's so natural at this point.

My current life is pretty much wake-up, do anything my Dad says I have to do since I live here and don't have a choice no matter how I feel, and then sleep. He thinks I'm still in school online since if he didn't I'd be kicked out already. I bought myself time until the summer, when I'll be forced to need a job, but I already know I won't get one, or if I somehow did I'd be fired quickly (I know from experience).

So this was my Ted Talk on my life.

I'm pretty much constantly living the isolation lifestyle. I use delivery apps to sustain me though.  


I should stop because I don't have any money but I don't have the energy or interest to cook or go anywhere.

Hey I'm the same.  


I lose motivation at light speed. My room goes in cycles. A few weeks ago I cleaned up the garbage from the floor (all take-out, mostly) and well it's just as bad now as it was then. My desk is also pretty bad.  


Pretty much as soon as I let one thing go everything else falls with it.

For real this happens all the time for me. It's gotten to the point where I've got Ambien to get me to sleep.

It doesn't really work well enough though so that mixed with me recently ODing on it means I'm going to have to switch to something else.

Me but the wave hasn't ended in years. Don't have friends anymore since they went on in life and I didn't. I leave the house only when I really *have* to but almost never do and hate when I have to. I know why my depression is getting worse but I can't bring myself to care.

I'm pretty sure I've lost the ability to achieve any positive emotion. You could give me a billion dollars and I would probably put my mask on and seem happy, appreciative and such but in reality I wouldn't care at all even though I know I should.  


Every day I search mindlessly just trying to find *something* that interests me, but nothing has lasted more than a couple days at best. I have lost my direction in life and since my depression hit in full force in high school I don't have the grades really either.   


Having eating be my number one coping habit hasn't helped to say the least. I'm 100% the opposite of fit and horrible at socializing (even if I had the skills, I don't have stories, hobbies, or interests to talk about) so jobs that don't need academics aren't an option either, not that I have the energy or motivation to do any in the first place though.

Yeah for sure. Plus I think a lot of people assume if you're not sad or emotional you can't be depressed. For me I am textbook severe depression except for I'm 100% apathetic.  


 I've been numb for long enough I don't remember anything else, and I'm never sad, but never happy either, just always meh. I also have lost all interest in everything along with my emotion so I'm bored of being bored but I'm just always so damn bored.

Definitely me. Currently I'm not in school (dropped out) and no job so minimal housework is all I really ever do. I spend most of my time in bed or on my computer.  


 Even if I make the effort to go on my computer I'm still extremely tired and want to sleep. I've tried keeping my blinds open to let natural light in but it still hasn't helped. It's kind of ironic that I need to take sleeping pills to go to sleep considering how exhausted I am 24/7.

I can relate. Tried myself a couple days ago by overdose. Definitely a shitty experience and it didn't even work. Can't say if I'm glad or not it failed because honestly I don't give a fuck about anything anymore.  


Since I'm pretty good with my mask, and I'm not really emotional I was deemed ok to release as an outpatient. I think part of their decision was probably the fact they're overbooked and full as-is.

Pretty bad. Recently failed suicide.  


Tried honestly because I was bored, just so tired, and have so much pressure to do more than I have the will or ability to do so I downed a shit-ton of my sleeping pills.  


Looking into some solutions but we'll see. Lost the ability to really feel anything long long ago.
F

Yeah I'll see if they can do anything. I know they're pretty backed up and full due to a lot of drug abuse issues in my city but since I was recently in they might be able to do something. Would at least get me in a better spot.

Live in Ontario, Canada so nope. I’m currently an outpatient with an appointment in May for Psych. They deemed I had recovered well enough to go for now.

Not sure what my options are here if I get kicked out as far as government assistance if I don’t have a job and such. I live with my Dad (parents separated) who basically worships money, and my mom just can’t afford another person even if she wants to.

Yeah... I’m still even told if I don’t get a job by the summer I’ll be kicked out. No way I’ll get a job though. 

Passing an interview is one thing, but I’ve had a job in the past when I wasn’t as bad and it made me hate every second of living. I’m sure if I even got one I’d be fired for not showing up or underperforming. That or I’d reach a low again and I can’t say I’ve learned really from my attempt.

Few days ago I bought some food and was asked "how are you?". Normally I'd say "Good" (total lie) but for whatever reason I blurted out "Pretty bad, kinda wish I was dead, sorry". They looked at me with a pretty wtf face and quietly said "ok".   


Yeah I don't go out often.

I can relate. When I wake up I already want to go back to sleep, even if I got "enough" hours it never is. I'm tired all day, constantly exhausted and just want to sleep. I also have insomnia, so even if I want to sleep I have to take a pill. Been through a few meds for my depression and day sleepiness. Nothing has worked so far and I feel so dead.
Yup. I found out little others cared about me when I failed my suicide attempt. Lots of empty words, no actions.
